title: Base64 Encoding
description: Write a Zig program that encodes a simple byte string to Base64 format.
hints: Base64 encodes 3 bytes into 4 characters using 6 bits each
Use bit shifting and masking: `>>`, `&`, `|` for bit manipulation
Pad with null bytes (0) when the input length is not divisible by 3
The `{c}` format specifier prints a single character from a u8 value
